drhp.business: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL) is a diversified financial services company focused on managing client wealth. It operates through Capital Markets (Institutional Equities, Investment Banking), Wealth Management (broking, distribution, lending for retail), Asset & Private Wealth Management (mutual funds, PMS, alternatives for HNI/UHNI), and Affordable Housing Finance. The group serves mass-affluent, HNI, UHNI, family offices, FIIs, DIIs, and corporate clients, underpinned by its 'Solid Research, Solid Advice' philosophy and QGLP investment framework.
